title: Protect Our Checks Rally at Bridgewater, NJ SSA Office
description:
Trump and the Republicans in Congress jeopardized the Social Security system by cutting staff and increasing budget deficits. They are taking health insurance and nutrition assistance away from millions of Americans, and making it more difficult to access because less staff leads to longer wait times.

Representative Tom Kean has voted for these changes which will harm many of us in CD7. Demand that Kean and the rest of congress restore funding and the administration improves Social Security’s customer service.

Meanwhile, House Republicans continue to prioritize tax breaks for billionaires over everyday people.

Join us for Protect Our Checks, a grassroots day of action demanding that Congress keep Social Security strong and accessible. We’ll uplift the stories of those who depend on it, call out those putting it at risk, and make it clear: Social Security is not negotiable. Bring your signs and bring your voices.

It’s time to choose people over profit.

title: Downtown Dripping Democracy Defenders
description:
As we have done now for months, the Dripping Springs, Texas-based "Downtown Dripping Democracy Defenders" meet EVERY SATURDAY MORNING at 9 am to OCCUPY the main intersection downtown at RR 12 and Hwy 290 West.  

We generally gather and park our cars at Veteran's Park, at the picnic tables, under the oak trees.  There are occasionally other community events scheduled at that location, but there is plenty of parking space even then.  We just do not always have the park to ourselves.

This is a law-abiding, joyful, peaceful protest where we make signs on site, or bring them from home, fly American flags and wave at our friends and neighbors as they drive past.  We get mostly positive responses, but there are always a few who seem not to like what we are doing, or who we are, or something.  We wave and smile at them, too!

Please join us every Saturday at 9 am, and in the event of bad weather, or some other unforeseen circumstance beyond out control, call this number to get an update:  ‭(512) 829-1626‬

Bring water, dress for the street corner conditions, and join with like-minded local citizens to express our First Amendment rights!

(We are meeting early to avoid the worst of our Texas summer heat, but we will likely alter our meeting times as the weather improves)
